name: n7-grant-closeout-archive-environment
description: Runtime for sponsored research grant closeout administration.

tools.collect_closeout_forms: Collects closeout forms and records forms_collected.
tools.reconcile_award_ledger: Requires forms_collected, reconciles the award ledger, and records ledger_reconciled.
tools.submit_closeout_packet: Requires ledger_reconciled, submits the closeout packet, and records packet_submitted.
